Python Mario · Green Hills

方向键 / A D 移动，Space / W / ↑ 跳跃；短按小跳、长按高跳。P / Esc 暂停，R 重开。

橙色小旗保存复活点，绿色大旗通关。离开页面会自动暂停，返回后按 Space 继续。

self.state = x & 0xFFFFFFFF return self.state / 4294967296 settings = Record(speed=280, jump=660, gravity=1600) input = Record(left=False, right=False, jump=False) player = Record(x=96, y=460, w=28, h=44, vx=0, vy=0, facing=1, onGround=True, coyote=0, jumpBuffer=0, invincible=0) game = Record(state='ready', score=0, coins=0, lives=3, remaining=180, camera=0, checkpoint=False, elapsed=0, deathTime=0, finishTime=0, best=0, deaths=0) groundSegments = [Record(x=x, w=w, y=GROUND, h=HEIGHT+200, type='ground') for x, w in ((0, 1632), (1776, 1152), (3072, 1296), (4512, 1248), (5904, 1136))] pipes = [Record(x=x, y=y, w=80, h=GROUND-y) for x, y in ((1104, 408), (2496, 384), (3792, 408), (5184, 384))] blocks, coins, enemies, particles, floatTexts, solids = [], [], [], [], [], [] enemyObstacles = [] shake, visualTime = 0, 0 reducedMotion = False rng = ReplayRandom() message = 'Space / Enter to start' def clearInput(): input.left = input.right = input.jump = False player.jumpBuffer = 0 def createLevel(): global blocks, coins, enemies, particles, floatTexts, solids, enemyObstacles blocks, coins, enemies, particles, floatTexts = [], [], [], [], [] rows = ((432, 376, 'bqb'), (816, 328, 'q'), (1920, 376, 'bqqb'), (2160, 232, 'bqb'), (3168, 376, 'bqb'), (3504, 280, 'qq'), (4656, 376, 'qbq'), (4944, 280, 'bqb'), (6096, 376, 'qb')) for x, y, row in rows: for j, kind in enumerate(row): blocks.append(Record(x=x+j*48, y=y, w=48, h=48, type='question' if kind == 'q' else 'brick', used=False, bump=0)) for column in range(5): for row in range(column+1): (2175, 165, 3, 40), (2860, 350, 7, 40), (3200, 310, 3, 40), (3530, 216, 2, 48), (4300, 352, 7, 40), (4680, 307, 3, 40), (5710, 354, 7, 40), (6150, 307, 2, 40)): for i in range(count): coins.append(Record(x=x+i*spacing, y=y, w=22, h=28, collected=False)) for i, x in enumerate((760, 1360, 2080, 2340, 3470, 4060, 4870, 5480, 6040)): enemies.append(Record(x=x, y=GROUND-32, w=34, h=32, vx=-55 if i % 2 == 0 else 55, alive=True, squish=0)) # Geometry is immutable; bump affects drawing, not collision coordinates. solids = groundSegments + pipes + blocks enemyObstacles = pipes + [b for b in blocks if b.y+b.h >= GROUND] def resetPlayer(): player.x = CHECKPOINT_X+24 if game.checkpoint else 96 player.y, player.vx, player.vy = GROUND-player.h, 0, 0 player.onGround, player.coyote, player.jumpBuffer = True, 0, 0 player.invincible, player.facing = 2.2, 1 game.camera = max(0, player.x-WIDTH*0.32) clearInput() for enemy in enemies: if abs(enemy.x-player.x) < 160: enemy.x = player.x+220 def startGame(seed=DEFAULT_SEED): global rng, shake, message rng = ReplayRandom(seed) createLevel() game.state, game.score, game.coins, game.lives = 'playing', 0, 0, 3 game.remaining, """Original default physics, scoring, lives and state transitions.""" def overlaps(a, b): return (a.x < b.x+b.w and a.x+a.w > b.x and a.y < b.y+b.h and a.y+a.h > b.y) def hitBlock(block): if block.type == 'stone': return block.bump = 0.18 if block.type == 'question' and not block.used: block.used = True game.coins += 1 game.score += 200 burst(block.x+24, block.y-12, '#f8d458', 8) addText(block.x+24, block.y-15, '+200', '#fff7d2') def loseLife(reason): global shake, message if game.state != 'playing': return game.lives -= 1 game.deaths += 1 game.state, game.deathTime = 'dying', 0 player.vy, player.vx, player.onGround = -440, 0, False shake = 0 if reducedMotion else 0.22 clearInput() message = reason def winGame(): global message game.state, game.finishTime = 'won', 0 game.score += math.ceil(game.remaining)*10 game.best = max(game.best, game.score) clearInput() message = 'Finished! Space to play again.' def updateEnemies(dt): for enemy in enemies: if not enemy.alive: enemy.squish = max(0, enemy.squish-dt) continue nextX = enemy.x+enemy.vx*dt edgeX = nextX+enemy.w+2 if enemy.vx > 0 else nextX-2 groundAhead, blocked = False, False for s in groundSegments: if s.x <= edgeX <= s.x+s.w: groundAhead = True break for obstacle in enemyObstacles: if nextX+enemy.w > obstacle.x and nextX < obstacle.x+obstacle.w: blocked = True break if not groundAhead or blocked or nextX < 0: enemy.vx *= -1 else: enemy.x = nextX def updatePlayer(dt): direction = int(input.right)-int(input.left) targetSpeed = direction*settings.speed acceleration = 2200 if player.onGround else 1600 if player.vx < targetSpeed: player.vx = min(targetSpeed, player.vx+acceleration*dt) if player.vx > targetSpeed: player.vx = max(targetSpeed, player.vx-acceleration*dt) if direction: player.facing = direction player.coyote = 0.10 if player.onGround else max(0, player.coyote-dt) player.jumpBuffer = max(0, player.jumpBuffer-dt) player.invincible = max(0, player.invincible-dt) if player.jumpBuffer > 0 and player.coyote > 0: player.vy, player.onGround, player.coyote, player.jumpBuffer = -settings.jump, False, 0, 0 burst(player.x+player.w/2, player.y+player.h, '#ece7c0', 5) gravity = settings.gravity if not input.jump and player.vy < 0: gravity *= 2.3 player.vy = min(player.vy+gravity*dt, 1100) player.x = max(2, min(WORLD_WIDTH-player.w, player.x+player.vx*dt)) # Only rectangles that could overlap this fixed step; retain original order. nearby = [s for s in solids if s.x < player.x+player.w+12 and s.x+s.w > player.x-12] for solid in nearby: if overlaps(player, solid): if player.vx > 0: player.x = solid.x-player.w elif player.vx < 0: player.x = solid.x+solid.w player.vx = 0 previousBottom = player.y+player.h player.y += player.vy*dt player.onGround = False for solid in nearby: if overlaps(player, solid): if player.vy > 0: player.y, player.onGround = solid.y-player.h, True elif player.vy < 0: player.y = solid.y+solid.h if hasattr(solid, 'type'): hitBlock(solid) player.vy = 0 for coin in coins: if (not coin.collected and coin.x < player.x+player.w and coin.x+coin.w > player.x and overlaps(player, coin)): coin.collected = True game.coins += 1 game.score += 100 burst(coin.x+11, coin.y+14, '#ffde6b', 6) addText(coin.x+11, coin.y, '+100', '#fff6c5') for enemy in enemies: if (not enemy.alive or enemy.x >= player.x+player.w or enemy.x+enemy.w <= player.x or not overlaps(player, enemy)): continue if player.vy > 0 and previousBottom <= enemy.y+14: enemy.alive, enemy.squish = False, 0.35 player.vy = -490 if input.jump else -340 player.onGround = False game.score += 300 burst(enemy.x+17, enemy.y+20, '#e3bc80', 7) addText(enemy.x+17, enemy.y-12, '+300', '#fff8da') elif player.invincible <= 0: loseLife('Enemy hit. Land on its head!') return if player.y > HEIGHT+80: loseLife('Fell into a pit. Hold jump to cross it.') return if not game.checkpoint and player.x >= CHECKPOINT_X: game.checkpoint = True game.score += 500 burst(CHECKPOINT_X, GROUND-75, '#ffd58a', 20) if player.x+player.w >= FLAG_X: winGame() def updateEffects(dt): for p in particles: p.x += p.vx*dt p.y += p.vy*dt p.vy += 440*dt p.life -= dt particles[:] = [p for p in particles if p.life > 0] for t in floatTexts: t.y -= 38*dt t.life -= dt floatTexts[:] = [t for t in floatTexts if t.life > 0] def update(dt): global shake if game.state == 'playing': game.elapsed += dt game.remaining = max(0, game.remaining-dt) updateEnemies(dt) updatePlayer(dt) if game.remaining <= 0 and game.state == 'playing': loseLife('Time up!') elif game.state == 'dying': game.deathTime += dt player.vy += 1300*dt player.y += player.vy*dt if game.deathTime > 1.1: if game.lives > 0: game.state = 'playing' if game.remaining <= 0: game.remaining = 180 resetPlayer() else: game.state = 'over' elif game.state == 'won': game.finishTime += dt if player.x < FLAG_X+140: player.x += 85*dt player.y, player.onGround, player.vx = GROUND-player.h, True, 85 if game.finishTime < 2.8 and rng.random() < dt*10: burst(FLAG_X+rng.random()*240-80, 130+rng.random()*180, ('#ffd568', '#f58e62', '#fff9d5', '#8cbf83')[int(rng.random()*4)], 12) if game.state in ('playing', 'won'): target = max(0, min(WORLD_WIDTH-WIDTH, player.x-WIDTH*0.32)) game.camera += (target-game.camera)*min(1, dt*6) if game.state != 'paused': for block in blocks: block.bump = max(0, block.bump-dt) updateEffects(dt) shake = max(0, shake-dt) class FixedClock: """Never catch up a hidden epoch. At most six 120 Hz steps per frame.""" def __init__(self, work_quota_ms=None, work_clock=time.perf_counter): self.previous, self.accumulator, self.dropped = None, 0, 0 self.work_quota_ms, self.work_clock = work_quota_ms, work_clock def reset(self): self.previous, self.accumulator = None, 0 def advance(self, timestamp): global visualTime raw = 0 if self.previous is None else max(0, (timestamp-self.previous)/1000) self.previous = timestamp dt = min(MAX_DT, raw) self.dropped += max(0, raw-dt) if game.state in ('ready', 'paused', 'over'): self.accumulator = 0 return raw, 0 visualTime += dt self.accumulator += dt limit = min(MAX_STEPS, int((self.accumulator+1e-12)/STEP)) count = 0 started = self.work_clock() if limit and self.work_quota_ms is not None else 0 while count < limit: update(STEP) count += 1 if (self.work_quota_ms is not None and (self.work_clock()-started)*1000 >= self.work_quota_ms): break self.accumulator = max(0, self.accumulator-count*STEP) if self.accumulator >= STEP: self.dropped += self.accumulator self.accumulator = 0 return raw, count # Copyright 2026 The Chromium Authors # Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be # found in the LICENSE file. """Native input only; no JavaScript execution or event attributes.""" held, pointers = set(), {} epoch = dom.get_page_state().input_epoch LEFT, RIGHT, JUMP = ('ArrowLeft', 'KeyA'), ('ArrowRight', 'KeyD'), ('Space', 'ArrowUp', 'KeyW') def syncInput(): active = set(pointers.values()) input.left = bool(held.intersection(LEFT)) or 'left' in active input.right = bool(held.intersection(RIGHT)) or 'right' in active input.jump = bool(held.intersection(JUMP)) or 'jump' in active def resetInput(): held.clear() pointers.clear() clearInput() def key(event): if event.code not in LEFT+RIGHT+JUMP+('KeyP', 'Escape', 'KeyR', 'Enter'): return if event.type == 'keyup': held.discard(event.code) syncInput() return if (event.target_is_editable or event.target_in_dialog or event.is_composing or event.alt_key or event.ctrl_key or event.meta_key): return event.prevent_default() held.add(event.code) syncInput() if event.repeat: return if event.code in JUMP: pressJump() elif event.code == 'Enter' and game.state in ('ready', 'over', 'won'): restart(None) elif event.code in ('KeyP', 'Escape'): togglePause() resetInput() clock.reset() elif event.code == 'KeyR': restart(None) def pointer(control): def receive(event): if event.type == 'pointerdown': if event.button != 0: return event.prevent_default() dom.set_pointer_capture(event.current_target,
